hero.lead: Bring your YouTube subscriptions into Hermes and organize them however you like. Pick a way to start — the others stay here for later.

pair.title: Connect the browser extension
pair.desc: Brings all your subscriptions and what you watch, straight from your browser. No password.

link.title: Paste a channel
link.desc: Paste a channel link or an @handle to follow it here, without the extension.

demo.title: Try the demo
demo.desc: 40 real public channels in 6 folders, to explore before connecting anything.
demo.loaded_desc: The demo is loaded. Clear it whenever you like — what you added stays.

pair.title: Connect the browser extension
pair.desc: Type this code in the extension to link your browser to Hermes.
pair.step_open: Open the extension in Chrome and type the code
pair.step_open_detail: Click the extension icon in the browser toolbar
pair.step_read_detail: The extension opens your subscriptions page in a tab for a few seconds; nothing in your account is changed
pair.expired_hint: This code expired. Create another one — it takes a second.
pair.connected_desc: This fills in by itself; it usually takes a few seconds.
pair.slow: The first read can take a few minutes when you follow many channels. You can close this — channels show up on their own.
pair.endpoint_down: The extension talks to Hermes only while Hermes is open. Keep it open (in the background is fine) and the extension reconnects by itself.

install.title: Don't have the extension yet?
install.body: In Chrome, open the Extensions page, turn on Developer mode and choose “Load unpacked” with the extension folder. Then pin it to the toolbar.

setup.title: Set up the extension
setup.desc: Hermes puts the HermesTube extension in a folder in your home folder and opens {browser}'s Extensions page. The browser then needs two clicks from you.
setup.no_browser_found: Hermes didn't find Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, Vivaldi or Opera on the computer where it runs. It can still prepare the folder; then open your browser's Extensions page yourself.
setup.update_title: A new version of the extension is ready
setup.update_desc: Hermes replaces the files in the same folder (version {version}). Then press Reload on the extension's card in the browser.
setup.step_folder: Hermes put the extension in a folder
setup.step_updated: Hermes updated the extension to version {version}
setup.step_drag: Drag the “HermesTube Extension” folder onto that page
setup.step_drag_detail: Or click “{load}” and choose the folder — its path can be copied above
setup.step_reload: Press Reload on the HermesTube card in {browser}
setup.step_reload_detail: On the browser's Extensions page. The extension stays connected to Hermes.
setup.step_code: Type the code below in the extension
setup.step_code_detail: The extension opens a tab by itself and asks for the code
setup.opened: {browser}'s Extensions page and the folder are open.
setup.opened_page_only: {browser}'s Extensions page is open. Use the path below to find the folder.
setup.other_computer: If Hermes runs on another computer, the folder was created there, not on this one. The extension only talks to a Hermes on the same computer, so follow the install guide on the computer where Hermes runs.

problem.no_browser: {browser} wasn't found on the computer where Hermes runs.
problem.no_display: The computer where Hermes runs has no screen to open {browser} on.
problem.failed: {browser} didn't start on the computer where Hermes runs.
problem.unsupported: Hermes can't open a browser on this system.

setup.manual_load_above: Click “{load}” and choose the folder above.
setup.manual_folder_later: Hermes creates this folder when you press “Set up the extension”.
setup.manual_code: Type the code below in the tab the extension opens (or click its icon in the toolbar).

chrome.where: The switch is at the top right of the Extensions page.

chromium.where: The switch is at the top right of the Extensions page.

edge.where: The switch is in the left-hand panel of the Extensions page (if the panel is hidden, open it with the menu button at the top left).

brave.where: The switch is at the top right of the Extensions page.

vivaldi.where: The switch is at the top right of the Extensions page.

opera.where: The switch is at the top right of the Extensions page.

arc.where: The switch is at the top right of the Extensions page.

generic.where: The switch is on the browser's Extensions page, usually at the top right.

sandbox.flatpak_title: {browser} is a Flatpak and can't see this folder yet
sandbox.flatpak_body: Give it read access to the folder once — run this in a terminal, then close and reopen the browser:
sandbox.snap_title: {browser} is a snap and can't see this folder
sandbox.snap_body: Snap browsers only see folders under /home. Use a version of the browser that is not a snap, or another browser.

ask.title: Stuck? Hermes can help
ask.desc: Opens a new chat with a ready request: your system, the folder, the browser and the steps. Nothing is sent until you press Send, and the request tells Hermes not to touch the browser's profile, not to skip the browser's own steps and not to install anything without asking.
ask.sent: A new chat has the request. Read it and press Send.
ask.failed: Hermes couldn't open a chat. Copy the request and paste it into a chat with Hermes:
ask.copy_desc: A ready request with your system, the folder, the browser and the steps, for a chat with Hermes. It tells Hermes not to touch the browser's profile, not to skip the browser's own steps and not to install anything without asking.

setup.remote_body: This button sets up the extension on that computer. The extension only talks to a Hermes on the same computer, so use the browser there.

wsl.title: Hermes runs inside WSL
wsl.localhost: The browser runs on Windows and reaches Hermes inside WSL through WSL's localhost forwarding, which is on by default. If the code never connects, use “{ask}” below.
wsl.no_interop: Hermes runs inside WSL with interop off: open the browser yourself.
wsl.wsl_disk: The folder is on the WSL disk: copy it to your Windows user folder if the browser refuses this path.

setup.not_ours_title: There's already a folder named “HermesTube Extension”
setup.not_ours_body: Hermes didn't create it, so it won't touch it. Rename or move that folder, then check again.
setup.error_title: Hermes couldn't set up the extension
setup.error_body: Try again, or follow the steps by hand below.
setup.read_failed: Couldn't check the extension folder yet — trying again on its own. The button works anyway.

ext_endpoint_down.title: Hermes couldn't open the connection to your browser
ext_endpoint_down.body: Close and reopen Hermes, then try again. If it keeps happening, another app may be in the way.

timeout.title: Hermes took too long to answer
timeout.body: It may still be starting up. Try again in a moment.

generic.title: We couldn't create a code
generic.body: Hermes didn't answer as expected. Try again.

link.title: Paste a channel
link.desc: A channel link, a video link or an @handle. You follow it here — nothing changes on YouTube.
link.label: Channel link or @handle
link.examples: For example @mkbhd, youtube.com/@3blue1brown or a video link

status.late: YouTube is slow — it shows up in your list in a moment

errors.empty: Paste a channel link or an @handle.
errors.format: That doesn't look like a YouTube channel. Use an @handle, a channel link or a video link.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find this channel on YouTube. Check the link or the @handle.
errors.rate_limited: YouTube is limiting requests right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.youtube_down: YouTube isn't answering right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.timeout: YouTube took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't add this channel. Try again.
errors.undo_failed: We couldn't undo it. Try again.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.desc: 40 real public channels in 6 folders, a few favorites and a topic tab. Nothing touches your YouTube account.
demo.loaded_desc: Demo channels are in your list. Clearing removes only them — anything you added stays.
demo.cleared_desc: Only the demo channels were removed.
demo.skipped: {count} of the demo channels were already yours and stayed as they were
demo.videos_later: Videos keep arriving in the background.
demo.rss_down: YouTube's feed is unstable right now — videos arrive little by little.

errors.load: We couldn't load the demo. Try again.
errors.clear: We couldn't clear the demo. Try again.

devices.title: Connected browsers
devices.desc: Browsers linked to Hermes through the extension.
devices.revoke_desc: Your subscriptions and folders stay here.
devices.revoke_effect_stop: The extension in this browser stops syncing with Hermes
devices.revoke_effect_again: To connect it again, create a new code here
devices.error: We couldn't load your connected browsers.

reach.remote_title: You're connected to {name}, not this computer
reach.remote_body: The extension talks to the Hermes on the computer where your browser is. Switch to {local} to set it up.
reach.off_body: You're in the “{profile}” profile. Go back to the profile where you installed it, or turn it on here: Capabilities → Plugins → HermesTube.
